_readme: Every failed or deferred test with a future retest date (Nov 28 2026). scripts/retests.py reads this file twice a week (retests.yml), resolves each date (after = sport:kind:year in data/seasons, plus lag days), and writes data/retests_state.json, which the ARKLOG retests tab and the Process overview read. how: watch = a workflow already reruns the test, the state is read from its output file; auto = run[] runs here and verdict{} decides, ship[] only on a pass; hand = a GitHub issue (label retest) opens on the date and a monthly task runs it. A finished retest gets result {d, v (s/f/m), e, tt, pr} here; the pull request's ARKLOG line is its log row. Add a test the day it fails or is deferred.
rule: A retest runs once on its trigger with the gate it was registered with; only a pass ships, a fail is recorded with its numbers.
